experiment: E04 - Control Impact Score definition, validation, benchmark

metric.definition: CIS(i) = 1 - S(G-i)/S(G), S = sum over ordered pairs of 1/d, d = unweighted directed shortest path
metric.convention: freeze-N (denominator N_F*(N_F-1) fixed at freeze time); free-N renormalization reported as diagnostic only
metric.primary_estimator: fixed-source-panel BFS (cis_bfs_panel): same k sources for all targets; per-target edge masking via COO; CIS = 1 - S_panel(G-i)/S_panel(G)
metric.secondary_diagnostic: reachable-pair fraction drop (reach_drop) from the same BFS pass

gate1_validation.v1_history: v1 suite FAILED 1/5 and exposed a denominator unit-mismatch bug (node count vs pair count) in cis_exact_full; fixed; v1 run preserved in RESEARCH_LOG.md E04
gate1_validation.k_sweep_insight: panel-to-panel stability is unmeasurable on structureless random graphs (all true CIS ~ 0; observed rho 0.63/-0.23/0.05/0.15 at k=64/128/256/512 = noise on a constant); stability must be assessed on structured graphs (rho>0.9 at k=30 on barbell fixture)

benchmark.hardware: local CPU (Windows, py 3.13.2); scipy dijkstra unweighted

decisions.computational_strategy: Strategy C (candidate-first) + panel estimator, two-stage k: screen candidates at k=8, re-rank finalists at k=32-64
